mission.posting: A direct and unaltered clone of this company's product has shown up on the market, giving the pirates profits for work that is not theirs. Take care of the offensive party.

email.subject: #CLIENT# - There can only be one
email.body:
Agent,
We at #CLIENT# recently released a new product onto an App Store and, while sales were solid for a few days, we recently saw a significant drop. We found that the cause of this was that a thief had stolen our app and was selling it on the store for less than our price. Competition is fine, but this is an unaltered clone of our original product! They are taking credit and money for *our* work! This has to be stopped
We would greatly appreciate your assistance in "solving" this problem for us. That is to way, we'd appreciate it if you destroyed anything and everything you could on their system. A link is attached.
Thankyou, -#CLIENT#
